title: 幼儿园功能区设计术语

intro.background: 现代幼儿园不是一排排课桌，而是按蒙台梭利理念划分的功能区：阅读区（Reading Corner）、美工区（Art Area）、建构区（Construction Zone）、角色扮演区（Role Play / Home Corner）、科学探索区、音乐区。温尚的功能教室整体定制就是围绕这些区做。客户问你们做不做阅读区，你要能对答如流。
intro.desc: 掌握功能区设计的英语术语，能和客户讨论空间规划方案。
tasks: 能用英语讨论空间规划

oneLiner.en: A modern classroom is not rows of desks — it is a series of beautifully designed learning zones.
oneLiner.cn: 现代教室不是一排排课桌——而是一系列精心设计的学习区。

vocab.ex: We design a cozy reading corner with low shelves.
vocab.exCn: 我们设计温馨的阅读角，配矮书架。

vocab.ex: The art area has easels and washable floors.
vocab.exCn: 美工区配备画架和可擦洗地面。

vocab.ex: The construction zone is for building blocks.
The home corner has a mini kitchen.
The sensory zone uses sand and water.

vocab.exCn: 低结构材料支持开放式游戏。
我们的家具遵循蒙台梭利理念。
所有家具都是儿童尺寸。

mistakes.right: We design complete learning environments — reading corners, art areas, and construction zones.
mistakes.cn: 错误：只说做桌椅。客户要的是完整功能区方案。

basic.en: We can design the reading corner for you.
basic.cn: 我们可以为您设计阅读角。

basic.en: The art area has a washable floor.

basic.cn: 我们的家具是儿童尺寸。
我们遵循蒙台梭利理念。

basic.en: The home corner includes a mini kitchen.
We can customize the zone layout.
basic.cn: 我们可以定制功能区布局。

advanced.en: Our package includes a reading corner with low bookshelves, an art area with easels and washable surfaces, all to Montessori child-height standards.
advanced.cn: 我们的套餐包括矮书架阅读角、画架可擦洗美工区，全部按蒙氏儿童身高标准。
advanced.from: We can design the reading corner for you.

advanced.en: We offer flexible zone layouts that can be reconfigured as your curriculum evolves.
advanced.cn: 我们提供灵活功能区布局，可根据课程调整。
advanced.from: We can customize the zone layout.

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: We want to redesign our classroom into learning zones. Can you help?
lines.cn: 我们想把教室改成功能区。你们能帮忙吗？

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Absolutely. We typically design seven zones: reading corner, art area, construction zone, home corner, sensory zone, science corner and music area. How old are the children?
lines.cn: 当然。我们通常设计七个区：阅读角、美工区、建构区、娃娃家、感官区、科学角、音乐区。孩子多大？

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Ages 3 to 5. We have about 60 square meters.

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Perfect. For 60 sqm, I suggest three main zones: reading corner, art area and home corner. We will propose a layout and furniture list within 3 days.
lines.cn: 好的。60平米建议三个区：阅读角、美工区、娃娃家。我们3天内出布局和家具清单。

fillBlank.q: The ____ corner is for reading books.

scenario.q: A client wants to redesign a 60 sqm classroom for 3-5 year olds. What do you propose?
scenario.modelAnswer: For 3-5 year olds in 60 sqm, I propose three core zones: a reading corner with low bookshelves, an art area with child-height easels, and a home corner with a mini kitchen. All furniture is child-sized following Montessori principles. We can send a layout and furniture list within 3 days.
scenario.cn: 对于3-5岁、60平米，我建议三个核心区：矮书架阅读角、儿童画架美工区、迷你厨房娃娃家。全部蒙氏儿童尺寸家具。3天内出布局和家具清单。

checklist: 我能介绍蒙氏设计原则
我能根据面积建议功能区组合

culture.title: 欧美幼儿园的功能区文化
culture.content: 欧美幼儿园强调孩子自主选择，功能区设计要体现：低矮家具孩子自取、灵活隔断、开放性材料loose parts、每个区有边界但不封闭。和欧美客户沟通时多用child-led、open-ended、self-access这些词，他们一听就知道你懂行。

rounds.ai: We want to redesign our classroom into learning zones. Can you help?
rounds.cn: 我们想把教室改成功能区，你们能帮忙吗？
rounds.hint: 介绍7大功能区，问年龄段和面积。

rounds.ai: We have 60 square meters for 3-5 year olds. What zones do you recommend?
rounds.hint: 推荐3个核心区，蒙氏原则。

rounds.ai: How soon can you send the layout?
